title: 第17章 精神力的作用第18章 矿脉解封
slug: 游戏入侵开局挖掌天瓶
content_zh:
悲空寺的封锁，在第三天傍晚终于解除。
苏寒佝偻着背，背着那个破烂的竹筐，从死矿道的阴影中缓缓走出。
主矿区里的景象，堪比人间炼狱。
三天的绝对封锁，意味着停工、停食。对于那些本就在温饱线上挣扎的底层矿工和新玩家来说，这三天就是一场残忍的自然淘汰。
一辆辆拉着尸体的木板车从苏寒面前碾过。车上堆叠着饿得皮包骨头的尸体，散发着难闻的酸臭味。几个侥幸活下来的新玩家，正趴在泥水里，为了半个沾满泥沙的馊馒头大打出手，像极了护食的野狗。
苏寒的眼神没有任何波动，脚步连停顿都没有，径直穿过这片绝望的营地，走向矿区边缘的黑市。
他现在的身体状况极度糟糕。极度饥饿导致他的脚步发虚，视野边缘甚至开始出现细微的黑斑。如果再不摄入高强度的能量，他的肌肉就会开始不可逆的溶解。
黑市里同样萧条，但在最深处那个挂着血色布帘的兽肉摊前，依然飘散着浓烈的肉香。
那是给矿区高层和高级监工准备的“特供品”。
“要什么？流民滚远点，这里没你吃得起的泔水。”满脸横肉的屠夫正在剔着一块不知名凶兽的肋骨，看都没看苏寒一眼。
苏寒没有废话。
他从怀里摸出一块指甲盖大小的碎银，约莫有一钱重，这是彪哥“赞助”的遗产之一。
“啪。”
碎银被苏寒屈指弹在沾满油污的案板上。
“两斤黑鳞猪肉干，一碗最浓的赤血汤。”苏寒的声音沙哑，透着一股不容置疑的冷硬。
屠夫的手一顿，浑浊的眼睛立刻亮了起来。他看了一眼苏寒那脏兮兮的脸，又看了看案板上的真金白银。在黑市，只认钱，不认人。
“好嘞！大爷您稍等！”
屠夫立刻换上了一副谄媚的笑脸。麻利地切下两斤风干得像石头一样的黑色兽肉，又从旁边的大铁锅里，舀出了一大碗浓稠如血浆、散发着刺鼻药味的浓汤。
苏寒端起滚烫的赤血汤，走到黑市外围一个无人的窝棚角落。
他没有像饿死鬼一样狼吞虎咽，那样只会让萎缩的胃部血管爆裂。

他先是抿了一小口赤血汤。
滚烫的浓汤顺着食道滑入胃袋，犹如吞下了一团炭火。但紧接着，一股极其庞大、狂暴的气血之力，在胃部轰然炸开。
“运转真气！”
苏寒立刻催动丹田内那一缕《八部天龙诀》的淡金色真气。
真气犹如一张贪婪的大网，瞬间扑向这股气血之力，将其强行绞碎、吸收，随后反哺向四肢百骸。
眩晕感在十秒内被一扫而空。
苏寒这才拿起那坚硬的黑鳞猪肉干，凭借着强化过的惊人咬合力，将肉干撕裂、嚼碎，和着赤血汤大口大口地吞咽下去。
半个时辰后。
两斤高阶兽肉和一碗大补的血汤，被苏寒彻底榨干了最后一丝营养。
他的脸色恢复了正常的苍白，双臂的肌肉再次充盈起来，甚至隐隐透出一股内敛的爆炸感。
苏寒靠在窝棚的烂木柱上，闭上眼睛，唤出了系统的属性面板。
【姓名：苏寒】
【等级：11】
content_en:
The blockade of Beikong Temple was finally lifted on the evening of the third day.
Su Han's back was bent, carrying the tattered bamboo basket, and he slowly walked out of the shadow of the dead mine tunnel.
The scene in the main mining area is comparable to hell on earth.
Three days of absolute lockdown means stoppage of work and food. For those low-level miners and new players who were already struggling to make ends meet, these three days were a cruel natural elimination.
Wooden carts carrying corpses passed by Su Han. The car was stacked with hungry, skinny corpses, exuding an unpleasant sour smell. A few new players who were lucky enough to survive were lying in the mud, fighting over half a bun covered in mud, like wild dogs guarding their food.
Su Han's eyes didn't waver, and his steps didn't even pause. He walked straight through this desperate camp and headed towards the black market on the edge of the mining area.
His current physical condition is extremely bad. Extreme hunger made his steps weak, and tiny black spots even began to appear on the edges of his vision. If he does not take in high-intensity energy, his muscles will begin to dissolve irreversibly.
The black market was equally depressed, but in front of the animal meat stall with a blood-colored curtain in the deepest part, there was still a strong aroma of meat.
That was a "special offering" prepared for the top management and senior supervisors of the mining area.
"What do you want? Refugees, stay away. There is no swill you can afford here." The butcher with a sinister face was picking at the ribs of an unknown beast without even looking at Su Han.
Su Han didn't talk nonsense.
He took out a piece of broken silver from his arms that was the size of a fingernail and weighed about a penny. This was one of the legacies "sponsored" by Brother Biao.
"Crack."
The broken silver was flicked by Su Han on the oily chopping board.
"Two kilograms of dried black scale pork, and a bowl of the thickest red blood soup." Su Han's voice was hoarse, with an unmistakable coldness.
The butcher's hand paused, and his cloudy eyes immediately lit up. He glanced at Su Han's dirty face, and then looked at the real money on the chopping board. In the black market, only money is recognized, not people.
"Okay! Master, please wait a moment!"
The butcher immediately put on a flattering smile. He quickly cut off two kilograms of black animal meat that was as dry as stone, and scooped out a large bowl of thick soup that was as thick as plasma and exuded a pungent medicinal smell from the large iron pot next to it.
Su Han picked up the boiling red blood soup and walked to an deserted corner of the shack outside the black market.
He didn't gorge himself like a starving man, which would only burst the blood vessels in his atrophied stomach.
He first took a sip of the red blood soup.
The hot soup slid down the esophagus and into the stomach, as if swallowing a ball of charcoal. But then, an extremely large and violent force of qi and blood exploded in his stomach.
"Run Qi!"
Su Han immediately activated the light golden energy of the "Eight Parts of Heavenly Dragon Art" in his dantian.
The true energy is like a greedy big net, instantly pounces on this energy and blood force, forcibly crushes and absorbs it, and then feeds it back to the limbs and bones.
The dizziness was swept away within ten seconds.
Su Han then picked up the hard black-scaled pork jerky, and with his amazingly strengthened bite force, he tore the jerky apart, chewed it into pieces, and swallowed it with large gulps of the red blood soup.
Half an hour later.
Two kilograms of high-grade animal meat and a bowl of tonic blood soup were completely drained of the last trace of nutrition by Su Han.
His face returned to its normal paleness, and the muscles in his arms became full again, and there was even a faint sense of restrained explosion.
Su Han leaned against the rotten wooden pillar of the shack, closed his eyes, and called up the system's property panel.
[Name: Su Han]
【Level: 11】
